# awscc_iot_ota_update (Resource)

Creates an IoT OTA update on a target group of things or groups.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Attributes List) The files to be streamed by the OTA update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `ota_update_id` (String) The ID of the OTA update to be created.
- `targets` (List of String) The devices targeted to receive OTA updates.

### Optional

- `additional_parameters` (Map of String) A list of additional OTA update parameters, which are name-value pairs.
- `aws_job_abort_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_job_abort_config))
- `aws_job_executions_rollout_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_job_executions_rollout_config))
- `aws_job_presigned_url_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_job_presigned_url_config))
- `aws_job_timeout_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_job_timeout_config))
- `description` (String) The description of the OTA update.
- `protocols` (List of String) The protocol used to transfer the OTA update image.
- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role that grants AWS IoT Core access to the Amazon S3, IoT jobs and AWS Code Signing resources to create an OTA update job.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Metadata which can be used to manage updates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `target_selection` (String) Specifies whether the update will continue to run (CONTINUOUS), or will be complete after all things specified as targets have completed the update (SNAPSHOT).

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date when the OTA update was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_date` (String) The date when the OTA update was last updated.
- `ota_update_arn` (String) The OTA update ARN.
- `ota_update_status` (String) The status of the OTA update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_ota_update.example
  identity = {
    ota_update_arn = "ota_update_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `ota_update_arn` (String) The OTA update ARN

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iot_ota_update.example
  id = "ota_update_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iot_ota_update.example "ota_update_arn"
```
